Ray Bones' Miami croquetas.d: Crisp crumb jacket, creamy center, nutmeg.
Ray Bones' Miami croquetas.note: Mind the jacket. Ask Ray Bones.

Cuban pastelitos.d: Puff pastry, guava paste, cream cheese, sugar.
Cuban pastelitos.note: A little South Beach before the meeting.

Chili Palmer's steak frites.note: He knows how this scene goes.

Harry Zimm's B-movie popcorn sundae.note: Half a million cheaper than a script.

Look-at-me Bloody Mary.note: House rule no. 1: look at me.
